crossRefs.note: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will…
I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh;
Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has…
Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.

translations.web: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have opened your graves, and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.
translations.bsb: Then you, My people, will know that I am the LORD, when I open your graves and bring you up from them.
translations.kjv: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,
translations.asv: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have opened your graves, and caused you to come up out of your graves, O my people.
